paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: ADMX sidecar cavity search with JTWPA. Exclusion of axion-photon coupling above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (axion mass ~19.835-19.847 ueV, centered at 19.84 ueV). DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cc. Exact limit shape varies with frequency (Fig. 7); approximate as flat at 1e-13 GeV^-1 over stated mass range. Note the abstract's '10^-13' is an approximate floor of the excluded region. | selector: text (sole candidate)
